look_here_first: Recognize ribbed globular to elongate cactus with striking multicolored long spines and large pink-to-purple flowers; compare areoles, ribs, and spine count to other cacti.
photo_note: Temporary first-photo species recognition only; independently reviewed diagnostic characters and county nativity must come later.
identification_caution: Mexico wild source photograph; modern subspecies taxonomy and Hays native range remain unresolved.
